mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a contractor for a whole-house remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for a whole-house remodel, prioritize experience with similar projects and a strong portfolio. Evaluate their communication style, ensure they are licensed and insured, and request references from previous clients. It's also important to discuss project management, timeline, and budget transparency upfront. A practical tradeoff to consider is between cost and experience; while a lower bid might seem appealing, a more experienced contractor often provides better project management and fewer unforeseen issues, potentially saving time and money in the long run.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with relevant experience, proper licensing, and good communication. Consider the practical tradeoff between cost and the value of an experienced, reliable contractor.
